DIAGNOSIS READY: Korsakoff Syndrome (likely secondary to chronic alcohol use disorder). The combination of amnestic-like inappropriate behavior, apathy, blunted affect, and specific food cravings (hypothalamic dysfunction) in the absence of diabetes is highly suggestive.
